_note: Baked backdrops for open-air dungeons (dungeon-backdrop.ts, BACKDROP.md). Read by the client and by tools/assets/bake_backdrop.mjs, so a vantage changed here is baked from here. from = [x, z, y] in the PARENT zone, y absolute metres. dir = the parent azimuth (radians, 0 = +z, pi/2 = +x) the dungeon's +z looks toward. time = dayFrac (0 sunrise, 0.25 noon, 0.5 sunset), the sky's fixed hour in the dungeon and the hour the bake renders. near = the bake's near clip: what stands closer to the vantage (the parent's own copy of the building) is left out. band = the elevations (degrees) the image covers, colour above, sky mask below.
